question: Can a fresh isolated WSLc session execute this pinned Python image with networking disabled and a read-only bind mount that rejects writes?
success_criteria: session starts with pre-created attempt-owned storage path
exact pinned image is pulled once and inspect succeeds
one container run emits JSON PASS and exits 0
exact-CID query reports no matching container
only this session is terminated successfully
failure_criteria: any timeout, missing or malformed receipt, nonzero command, failed assertion, unexpected cleanup result, or session termination ambiguity => HOLD/UNKNOWN; no retry
operations: start one named session via wslc system session enter, keep shell open
inspect exact image, perform one explicit pull in that named session
perform one run with --pull never --network none --memory 512M --cpus 1 --volume <probe-dir>:/probe:ro --rm --name <unique> --cidfile <unique-path>
query only exact CID after receipt
remove only exact pinned image in this session after verified container absence
prohibitions: no Docker; no global container/session inventory; no foreign state access/cleanup; no run network; no retries; no GUI/provider/input-release/recovery/task-effect claims
nonclaims: no Windows GUI input or release evidence
single sample does not establish reliability
